The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. statement: Assume Assumption 1.1. Let X be a normal irreducible compact Kähler complex analytic space, and let ∆ ≥ 0 be a rational divisor such that (X, ∆) is log canonical and KX + ∆ is rational Cartier. If KX + ∆ is analytically nef, then it is semiample. Explicitly, there is an integer m > 0 such that m(KX + ∆) is Cartier and H0 X, OX(m(KX + ∆))  ⊗C OX −→ OX(m(KX + ∆)) is surjective at every point of X.
